title: 瑞银胡一帆：为何服务业产出指数比零售数据更能反映消费？
speaker: You Song

segments.en: Right, can I ask you then why place less weight on retail sales at this one in time?
segments.zh: 那么请问，为什么此时对零售数据的权重降低？

segments.en: Not necessarily less weight, but relatively to service output index. The important, I think it's lower, just because the two tend to have much lower level of correlation.
segments.zh: 不一定是权重降低，而是相对于服务业产出指数，零售数据的重要性较低，因为两者相关性较低。

segments.en: One reason is it's not a good, necessarily a good proxy for overall consumption. Which is often assumed to be the case.
segments.zh: 一个原因是零售数据未必是整体消费的良好代理指标，尽管人们常这么认为。

segments.en: Don't want to dismiss it, which is, it's meaningful. I think one way we try to gauge the likely outcome in terms of two Q GDP, the service output index is way more important.
segments.zh: 我不想忽视它，它有意义。但衡量二季度GDP可能结果时，服务业产出指数重要得多。

segments.en: Right, so how would you, on aggregate, how would you describe consumption at this point then?
segments.zh: 那么总体而言，你如何描述当前的消费状况？

segments.en: Conception is clearly not strong. So from one Q, there definitely was a meaningful slowdown.
segments.zh: 消费显然不强。从一季度开始，确实出现了明显的放缓。
